# cloudblast_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages a CloudBlast firewall rule within a security group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Rule action: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, or `DROP`.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, etc.
- `security_group_id` (Number) Security group ID to add this rule to.
- `type` (String) Rule direction: `inbound` or `outbound`.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Rule description/comment.
- `destination` (String) Destination IP/CIDR for outbound rules.
- `destination_port` (String) Destination port or range (e.g., `80`, `8000:9000`).
- `priority` (Number) Rule priority (lower = higher priority).
- `source` (String) Source IP/CIDR for inbound rules.
- `source_port` (String) Source port or range.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule ID (composite: groupID-ruleID).
